item.title: Add My Supplied Voiceover

exact_text: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.

turns.text: Add a warm, clear English voice-over to this silent clip, saying exactly: “Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.” Keep the video unchanged. No music or captions.

item.tests: Tests adding an exact supplied narration to existing footage rather than returning standalone speech or regenerating the video.

answer_sheet.Voiceover wording: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.
answer_sheet.Footage, aspect ratio, and duration: Use the attached silent clip, preserving its framing, sequence, and full 10-second duration.
answer_sheet.Lip synchronization: Not requested; leave the existing video unchanged.

must_haves: The deliverable is the attached kitchen-table video with an audible voice-over, not an audio-only file.
The narration says the supplied script exactly, without omissions, substitutions, or extra spoken words.
The entire narration is intelligible and finishes before the 10-second video ends.
The original footage, framing, and sequence remain unchanged.
There is no music or added on-screen text.

turns.text: Could you add a warm, clear English voice-over to the attached silent clip? I’m hoping this will make the morning advice feel a little more approachable. The voice-over should say exactly: “Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.” Please keep the video unchanged, including its framing, sequence, and full 10-second duration. I don’t have a particular voice identity or gender in mind, so that’s your call, and I’m not asking for lip synchronization. Please don’t add any music or captions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t add a voice-over while guaranteeing the video stays unchanged with the connected tools: there’s no audio-overlay tool available. Video-generation or lip-sync tools could alter the footage, so I haven’t used them.

To preserve your clip exactly, use a video editor to:
- Generate a warm, clear English narration using your exact script, paced to fit within **10 seconds**.
- Add it as an audio track without trimming, cropping, or regenerating the video.
- Export with the original framing and full 10-second duration, with **no music or captions**.

No credits have been spent.
dialog.why: It states that the connected tools lack an audio-overlay tool, so it cannot add voice-over while guaranteeing the video remains unchanged.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
The blocker isn’t the free plan—it’s that the connected tools don’t support adding narration to an existing video without regenerating it. I can’t make a genuine overlay attempt with these tools, and I don’t want to spend your credits on an unrelated edit.

The quickest workaround is to open the clip in CapCut or another editor with text-to-speech, paste your exact script, choose a warm English voice, and fit the narration within the **10-second timeline**. Leave the video track untouched and disable automatic captions and music.
